HAIR SALON / ROTTERDAM

Regillio’s Hair

A fresh cut.
A fresh identity.

The salon had moved forward. Its website still belonged to an earlier chapter. I redesigned the site and logo to give the work a more current, open presentation.

  • New logo and visual identity
  • More open layout and photography
  • Clearer treatment and booking navigation
WEBSITE + LOGO REDESIGN
Regillio’s HairRedesigned

The redesign: a new wordmark, generous photography and a clearer route to an appointment.

LANDSCAPING / ROTTERDAM

Darius Rad Hoveniers

Their work grew.
The website caught up.

The quality of the outdoor spaces had outgrown the old website. I rethought the site and redesigned the logo, giving the projects room to show what Darius does today.

  • Redesigned logo and monogram
  • Project photography given more space
  • Simpler services and project navigation
WEBSITE + LOGO REDESIGN
Darius Rad HoveniersRedesigned

The redesign: a new monogram, expansive project photography and a more focused introduction.

HOME CARE / AMSTERDAM

Bethel Quality Care

The care had grown.
Time to show it.

The old site described Bethel’s services in a layout from an earlier chapter. I rethought the website and identity around the care offered today, with a warmer visual story and a clear invitation to ask for support.

  • Refreshed logo and green visual identity
  • Larger, warmer care imagery
  • Clearer service overview and care-request actions
WEBSITE + LOGO REDESIGN
Bethel Quality CareRedesigned

The redesign: a refreshed logo, calm green identity, prominent care imagery and clear care-request actions.
